sources.title: GitHub - HarunRRayhan/bangla-asr-whisper-cpp
sources.snippet: A Bangla (Bengali) automatic speech recognition model converted for use with whisper.cpp, the C/C++ inference engine for OpenAI's Whisper. This repo contains the converted model weights only — no training code or datasets are included.
